fields.name: topMargin
fields.label: Top Margin (Optional)
fields.description: Overrides the block top margin. Accepts CSS lengths like 24px, 4rem, or 0. Plain numbers default to px.

fields.name: topPadding
fields.label: Top Padding (Optional)
fields.description: Defaults to a large no-header offset. Accepts CSS lengths like 128px, 8rem, or 0. Plain numbers default to px.

fields.name: bottomPadding
fields.label: Bottom Padding (Optional)
fields.description: Overrides the block bottom padding. Accepts CSS lengths like 72px, 4rem, or 0. Plain numbers default to px.

fields.name: contentWidth
fields.label: Content Width (Optional)
fields.description: Defaults to 1040px. Accepts any CSS length.
